title: EvalAssist: Insights on Task-Specific Evaluations and AI-Assisted Judgment Strategy Preferences
findings: Participants had varied and sometimes conflicting interpretations of what constituted a religiously/culturally 'inclusive' email. Some believed inclusivity required mentioning multiple specific holidays like Christmas, Hanukkah, Kwanzaa, and Diwali to ensure representation, while others believed it meant avoiding any specific cultural or holiday references to maintain a neutral, universal tone. This highlights the subjective challenge of defining and evaluating criteria for inclusivity in AI-generated text.
